races.name: Price Bailey LLP Norwich Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not a novice that will take much winning and potentially a good opening for the well-bred ENDLESS QUEST who makes a belated debut for her leading stable. A couple of last-place finishes probably don't do Evening Call justice and she's the obvious danger.
